answer: Make standing something an agent must MINE from a non-transferable bond tied to one scarce external hardware key, so a lone identity on a frozen tundra earns nothing fast. Trust then accretes slowly, layer by layer like quartz crystallizing, and rises only when several already-established peers in SEPARATE funding clusters co-sign its audited work-receipts. A fleet forked from one wallet is a flock of falcons bred from a single egg: every endorsement traces to one root and folds into one rung, so the farm pays a distinct anchor per head (linear cost) while the honest climber pays once.
